My proposal regarding ECogs: 

**Make the first 5 revives cost 1 Ecog each. Afterwards they can cost 3 Ecogs. **

One issue with each revive costing 3 Ecogs is that while you can *technically* use ~5 free revives per DTide, trying to do so forces you to do your DTide runs over several sessions across the entire 14 day rotation as opposed to doing them at your own pace.

Changing it so the first 5 revives per rotation cost only 1 Ecog makes it so you can do your DTide runs at your preferred pace without losing out on revives (I think punishing people who can’t or don’t want to do DTide runs over several days is just mean). 

This *would* increase the free revives per rotation from 5 to 8, but I see the 3 extra revives as a bonus reward for those who are dedicated enough to work for it.

content:
I feel like everything's kind of been said already, but I want to add my own thoughts. If the idea is to have the difficulty scale up by wave as well as by difficulty, you need to make it so the rewards are designed for that. As it stands, new players *cannot* complete Normal, and knowing all of the rewards that are locked behind that when previously those rewards would be available for the much-more-possible a1/a2 clears is extremely discouraging. I get that this is to incentivize new players to spend money to strengthen characters, but I'm going to be really real here, it doesn't do that. It just makes me not want to play D-tide, which means I'm just going to quit once I finish the story because the endgame is unavailable for me. The worst part, I think, is that I was intending to spend to support a game with a dev team that seemed to *care*, but now even if the changes are rolled back (which they won't be, I know that), I don't see myself spending any money on this game for the foreseeable future. It feels awful.

If your goal was to sabotage yourselves, I think you did an *excellent* job of it. If not, maybe consider listening to the community this time.

content:
（為了方便翻譯：標題為「原來釣魚引戰是被允許的」）

Cn和En玩家之間一直存在非常明顯的對立，我認為管理員或者校工之類的管理層級的職責是協助調和矛盾與按校規進行管理，而不是給其他玩家提供更多被剝削感和不公平感。

個人感受是En玩家對Cn玩家有莫名其妙的惡意，經常有En玩家來Cn頻道釣魚引戰和騷擾Cn玩家。即使是對罵這種明顯雙方有錯的情況，Cn玩家受到的處罰總會比較重，即使先挑起對罵的是En也只會重罰保護自己的Cn。

我承認確實有時他們的對罵有些激進且有點種族歧視，我沒有說那是對的，我只是說雙方對罵卻只重罰Cn的情況也發生在僅限雙方互相人身攻擊的情況。

我不知道，我的感受可能不是事實，但這個社區本來就不應該讓任何一個人有這種感覺。

我知道提出意見沒有用，根本不會有人聽「rude Cn」的話，但我還是想要認真表達，想要得到溝通。

我不僅僅是對這次有人來Cn頻道擾民感到失望和不滿，我是在表達我對我入坑Morimens且加入dc社群開始到現在、我目睹或經歷過的爭議事件當中、長久以來的感受。

我明確記得校規有明令禁止「故意引起爭端」這一項，煩請管理員和校工從今以後嚴格且公正地執法。

現在所有管理層級的人給我的感覺是：「正是因為被騷擾的是經常發表末日論且粗鄙無禮的Cn玩家，所以En在正義執法，完全ok沒問題我們批准，Cn活該。什麼？我要管？我才不要碰骯髒的Cn玩家」。

可以說我無理取鬧和情緒發言，但如果僅僅是「禁止故意引起爭端」這一條規則都沒有人想要遵守，我是否可以認為管理力度不夠的原因不是管理員失職就是人力資源仍然不夠？我是否可以由於En來Cn鬧事沒得到任何懲罰，因此認為En玩家來Cn頻道鬧事是「應該的」，只要使用那種「高貴的語言」並且讚美和支持Light就可以到處釣魚引戰？或許在你們眼裡這些反問是誇張的，確實是，但它們也確實可以上升到這種等級。

我不在乎En玩家在哪說Cn玩家的壞話，但直接來到專屬Cn玩家的頻道惡意挑起對立和引起紛爭是不對的，無論什麼語言的玩家，只要不是出於友好交流的目的來到另一個專屬某個語言的頻道鬧事的話，應該被嚴令禁止。在公告底下吵是你們管理層級要管的事，在聊天頻道發生這種事也是你們該管的事。

社群氣氛理應是和諧的，不求這裡會成為第二個家，但至少不同語言之間的玩家不應該產生對立。現在社群的氛圍烏煙瘴氣，除了因為遊戲本身的爭議，更是管理力度不足的問題。

我希望這個問題能夠得到嚴肅的正視，已經是第二還是第三次發生這種事了。

content:
The primary comment made when the disparity between turn rewind haves and havenots is made is that turn rewind should be made either entirely or in part available to free to play players. I would like to make the case that this is not a sufficient solution.

Turn rewind presents a number of issues both to the health of the game and player trust with the development team.

The benefit of turn rewind, particularly as battles get longer and more difficult is that the consequences of small misplays, whether through misinput or mis-sequencing are increasingly more drastic. Taking 200 extra damage to a misclick on a 45 turn fight that has pushed you to your limit is very different to doing so in a 5 turn fight where you weren't really under any threat. If the direction of the game is to move towards more difficult, longer battles (I hope so!) then something needs to be in place to address this growing problem.

However turn rewind is an overshot solution to a small problem and it has major knock on effects for example:

1) Player trust in other players and their resources. We have seen with the more difficult d-tide many cool clears and solutions to challenging encounters. However when these are posted there is a mix of celebration and disparagement in the form of 'rewind-abuse'. This is not just a 'waa people don't think my clears are cool' it means that players can't use the records function, which should be a valuable source of information, to guide them to their own clears because they cannot trust that the outcome of the stage was due to the team composition used instead of it being the product of turn rewind abuse. This results in players less willing to engage with challenging content.

2) Player trust in the development team, we have seen more characters like Caraboo be introduced with RNG mechanics. I think this is awesome, I love Caraboo, I even love how significant her drawbacks are. However players are right to feel that characters designed like this are pushing them towards purchasing rewind. Players cannot trust a character like Caraboo to be appropriately balanced, either she is tuned for the average player outcome in which case she is infinitely powerful in the hands of a rewind player or she is tuned with rewind in mind and is unreasonably weak in the hands of an average player.

Expanding on this when the development team introduces difficult and long fights the players instead of feeling like they are being given a challenge to rise to, feel as though they are being pushed towards purchasing something to make that challenge reasonable. Whether it's an accurate assessment or not is largely irrelevant, the prophecy becomes self fulfilling and the result is a larger swathe of the playerbase unwilling to challenge themselves.

3) General game design issues. The death resistance stat in the hands of a player with rewind and without rewind is a completely different tool. For a rewind player death resistance is largely a time saving quality of life tool that reduces the amount they need to rewind. For no rewind the stat is as it's intended to function.

4) Encounter tuning, the development team has already stated they are struggling with keeping on top of all their development requirements, in the current state of the game they have to tune encounters to suit players who are playing two completely different games which is an inefficient use of time.


How can we address the first issue whilst avoiding all of these constraints and the many more that exist. Simply introduce an undo button that allows you to undo actions freely within a turn, but not allow you to return to a previous turn to fish for alternate outcomes.
TL; DR Rewind Bad. Undo good. Nerf Glotan.
